en.content:
16:9, PIXAR-STYLE ANIMATION, in the dark ocean background, the evil giant squid is shown holding each of the fish trapped with its suckers and tentacles: a small yellow boxfish with a tiny snail on its head and a light coming out of its forehead, the violet devil fish, the gray pufferfish, and the black fish. Staring at them intently, it asks where they are going.
